narrative.text: Presents WHO Summary Table 4 (updated December 2025) on the immunization of health care workers (HCWs), categorizing 25 antigens into those recommended for HCWs (BCG, Hepatitis B, Polio, Diphtheria, Measles, Rubella, Meningococcal, Influenza, Varicella, and Pertussis) and those without current HCW-specific recommendations (Tetanus, Hib, Pneumococcal, Rotavirus, HPV, Japanese Encephalitis, Yellow Fever, Tick-Borne Encephalitis, Typhoid, Cholera, Hepatitis A, Rabies, Mumps, Dengue TAK-003, and Malaria), along with position paper references and footnotes.
